name: MetricSpace.eq_of_dist_eq_zero
initialProofState:
α : Type u
self : MetricSpace α
x y : α
a✝ : Eq (Dist.dist x y) 0
⊢ Eq x y
decl:
/-- We now define `MetricSpace`, extending `PseudoMetricSpace`. -/
class MetricSpace (α : Type u) extends PseudoMetricSpace α : Type u where
  eq_of_dist_eq_zero : ∀ {x y : α}, dist x y = 0 → x = y

name: MetricSpace.ext_iff
initialProofState:
α : Type u_3
m m' : MetricSpace α
⊢ Iff (Eq m m') (Eq PseudoMetricSpace.toDist PseudoMetricSpace.toDist)
decl:
/-- Two metric space structures with the same distance coincide. -/
@[ext]
theorem MetricSpace.ext {α : Type*} {m m' : MetricSpace α} (h : m.toDist = m'.toDist) :
    m = m' := by
  cases m; cases m'; congr; ext1; assumption

name: eq_of_dist_eq_zero
initialProofState:
γ : Type w
inst✝ : MetricSpace γ
x y : γ
a✝ : Eq (Dist.dist x y) 0
⊢ Eq x y
decl:
theorem eq_of_dist_eq_zero {x y : γ} : dist x y = 0 → x = y :=
  MetricSpace.eq_of_dist_eq_zero

name: dist_eq_zero
initialProofState:
γ : Type w
inst✝ : MetricSpace γ
x y : γ
⊢ Iff (Eq (Dist.dist x y) 0) (Eq x y)
decl:
@[simp]
theorem dist_eq_zero {x y : γ} : dist x y = 0 ↔ x = y :=
  Iff.intro eq_of_dist_eq_zero fun this => this ▸ dist_self _

name: zero_eq_dist
initialProofState:
γ : Type w
inst✝ : MetricSpace γ
x y : γ
⊢ Iff (Eq 0 (Dist.dist x y)) (Eq x y)
decl:
@[simp]
theorem zero_eq_dist {x y : γ} : 0 = dist x y ↔ x = y := by rw [eq_comm, dist_eq_zero]

name: dist_ne_zero
initialProofState:
γ : Type w
inst✝ : MetricSpace γ
x y : γ
⊢ Iff (Ne (Dist.dist x y) 0) (Ne x y)
decl:
theorem dist_ne_zero {x y : γ} : dist x y ≠ 0 ↔ x ≠ y := by
  simpa only [not_iff_not] using dist_eq_zero

name: dist_le_zero
initialProofState:
γ : Type w
inst✝ : MetricSpace γ
x y : γ
⊢ Iff (LE.le (Dist.dist x y) 0) (Eq x y)
decl:
@[simp]
theorem dist_le_zero {x y : γ} : dist x y ≤ 0 ↔ x = y := by
  simpa [le_antisymm_iff, dist_nonneg] using @dist_eq_zero _ _ x y

name: dist_pos
initialProofState:
γ : Type w
inst✝ : MetricSpace γ
x y : γ
⊢ Iff (LT.lt 0 (Dist.dist x y)) (Ne x y)
decl:
@[simp]
theorem dist_pos {x y : γ} : 0 < dist x y ↔ x ≠ y := by
  simpa only [not_le] using not_congr dist_le_zero

name: eq_of_forall_dist_le
initialProofState:
γ : Type w
inst✝ : MetricSpace γ
x y : γ
h : ∀ (ε : Real), GT.gt ε 0 → LE.le (Dist.dist x y) ε
⊢ Eq x y
decl:
theorem eq_of_forall_dist_le {x y : γ} (h : ∀ ε > 0, dist x y ≤ ε) : x = y :=
  eq_of_dist_eq_zero (eq_of_le_of_forall_le_of_dense dist_nonneg h)

name: eq_of_nndist_eq_zero
initialProofState:
γ : Type w
inst✝ : MetricSpace γ

a✝ : Eq (NNDist.nndist x y) 0

decl:
/-- Deduce the equality of points from the vanishing of the nonnegative distance -/
theorem eq_of_nndist_eq_zero {x y : γ} : nndist x y = 0 → x = y := by
  simp only [NNReal.eq_iff, ← dist_nndist, imp_self, NNReal.coe_zero, dist_eq_zero]

name: nndist_eq_zero
initialProofState:

inst✝ : MetricSpace γ

decl:

@[simp]
theorem nndist_eq_zero {x y : γ} : nndist x y = 0 ↔ x = y := by
  simp only [NNReal.eq_iff, ← dist_nndist, imp_self, NNReal.coe_zero, dist_eq_zero]

initialProofState:

name: Metric.closedBall_zero
initialProofState:

⊢ Eq (Metric.closedBall x 0) (Singleton.singleton x)
decl: @[simp] theorem closedBall_zero : closedBall x 0 = {x} := Set.ext fun _ => dist_le_zero

name: Metric.sphere_zero
initialProofState:

name: Metric.subsingleton_closedBall
initialProofState:
γ : Type w
inst✝ : MetricSpace γ
x : γ
r : Real
hr : LE.le r 0
⊢ (Metric.closedBall x r).Subsingleton
decl:
theorem subsingleton_closedBall (x : γ) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≤ 0) : (closedBall x r).Subsingleton := by
  rcases hr.lt_or_eq with (hr | rfl)
  · rw [closedBall_eq_empty.2 hr]
    exact subsingleton_empty
  · rw [closedBall_zero]
    exact subsingleton_singleton

name: Metric.subsingleton_sphere
initialProofState:
γ : Type w
inst✝ : MetricSpace γ
x : γ
r : Real
hr : LE.le r 0
⊢ (Metric.sphere x r).Subsingleton
decl:
theorem subsingleton_sphere (x : γ) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≤ 0) : (sphere x r).Subsingleton :=
  (subsingleton_closedBall x hr).anti sphere_subset_closedBall

name: MetricSpace.replaceUniformity_eq
initialProofState:
γ : Type u_3
U : UniformSpace γ
m : MetricSpace γ
H : Eq (uniformity γ) (uniformity γ)
⊢ Eq (m.replaceUniformity H) m
decl:
theorem MetricSpace.replaceUniformity_eq {γ} [U : UniformSpace γ] (m : MetricSpace γ)
    (H : 𝓤[U] = 𝓤[PseudoEMetricSpace.toUniformSpace]) : m.replaceUniformity H = m := by
  ext; rfl

name: MetricSpace.replaceBornology_eq
initialProofState:
α : Type u_3
m : MetricSpace α
B : Bornology α
H : ∀ (s : Set α), Iff (Bornology.IsBounded s) (Bornology.IsBounded s)
⊢ Eq (m.replaceBornology H) m
decl:
theorem MetricSpace.replaceBornology_eq {α} [m : MetricSpace α] [B : Bornology α]
    (H : ∀ s, @IsBounded _ B s ↔ @IsBounded _ PseudoMetricSpace.toBornology s) :
    MetricSpace.replaceBornology _ H = m := by

  rfl
